content: Koyro Tamaareta Xeegethaa
Issi gallas Yesuusi Gensareexe Abbaa matan eqidashin daro asay iya yuushuwa un7ethidi, I tamaarsiya Xoossaa qaala si7oosona.
Yan haatha gaxan de7iya nam7u wogolota be7is. Molo oykiya asati wogolotape wodhidi banta gitiya meeccosona.
He wogolotape Simoonaysan gelidi biittafe guuthi giddo shiishana mela oychis. Yaatidi, he wogoluwa bolla uttidi asaa tamaarsis.
Ba timirtiya ongidaape guye Simoonako, “Gede ciimmuwako shiishada moluwa oykanaw hinte gitiya yeggite” yaagis.
Simooni zaaridi, “Astamaariyaw, qamma kumethi daaburishe aqidi aykoka oykibooko, shin ne giiko gitiya yeggana” yaagis.
Enti gitiya yeggida wode gitey daaketana gakanaw daro molo oykidosona.
Hara wogolon de7iya banta laggeti yidi, bantana maaddana mela wuttidi xeegidosona. Enti yidi nam7u wogoloti, haathan mitettana gakanaw molon kunthidosona.
Simoon Phexroosi hessa be7ida wode, Yesuusa sinthan kundidi, “Godaw, taani nagarancho asi gidiya gisho, taape shaaketa” yaagis.
I hessa giday, inne iyara de7eysati oykida moluwa darotethan malaaletida gishosa.
Qassi Simoona lagge gidida Zabdiyoosa nayti Yayqoobaranne Yohaanisara malaaletidosona. Yesuusi Simoonako, “Babofa! Hizape neeni ase oykiya asi gidana” yaagis.
Enti wogolota gaxa shiishidaape guye ubbaa aggidi Yesuusa kaallidosona.
Baro Harganchoy Paxis
Yesuusi katamatape issuwan de7ishin issi baro hargen
oyketida asi he kataman de7ees. He uray Yesuusa be7idi iya sinthan gufannidi, “Godaw, ne shene gidiko tana geeshshanaw danda7aasa” gidi woossis.
Yesuusi ba kushiya yeddi bochidi, “Ee, ta shene; geeyiya” yaagis. Iira baro hargey uraape kichis.
Yesuusi, “Haysa oodeska odopa, shin bada nenatethaa Ayhude kahine bessa. Ne geeyidaysas marka gidana mela Musey kiitida yarsho yarsha” gidi kiittis.
Gidoshin, iya sunthay kasepe aadhidi eretishe bis. Daro asay I odiyaba si7anawunne banta hargiyafe paxanaw yoosona.
Shin Yesuusi daro wode geema bessi bidi woossees.
Gunda Ura
Issi gallas Yesuusi tamaarsishin Galilapenne Yihuda heera ubbaafe qassi Yerusalaamepe yida Farsaawetinne higge astamaareti yan uttidosona. Asaa pathiya Godaa wolqayka iyara de7ees.
He wode asay issi gunda asi halara tookidi ehidosona. Soo gelsidi iya sinthan wothanaw qopidosona.
Shin asaa darotethaafe dendoysan soo gelsanaw xoonetidi keethaa bolla keyidi, kaara qawuxidi, harganchuwa halara asaa shaakidi Yesuusa sinthan yeggidosona.
Yesuusi enta ammanuwa be7idi, “La addiyaw, ne nagaray atto geetetis” yaagis.
Higge astamaaretinne Farsaaweti, “Haysi Xoossaa bolla yaagidi odetey oonee? Issi Xoossafe attishin, hari nagara atto gaanaw danda7ey oonee?” yaagidi qopidosona.
Yesuusi enta qofaa erida gisho entako, “Hinte wozanan hessatho ayis qopeetii?
‘Ne nagaray qushetis geysafenne dendada ba geysafe awusi kawuyii?’
Shin ta hessa giday Asa Na7i sa7a bolla nagara ato gaanaw maati de7eysa hinte erana melasa.” Hessafe kaallidi, gunda uraako, “Denda; ne algaa tookada ne soo ba” yaagis.
I ellesi dendidi enta sinthan eqis; I tooketidi yida algaa tookidi Xoossaa galatishe ba soo bis.
He wode ubbayka malaaletidosona. Xoossaa galatishe, “Hachi gita malaata be7ida” yaagidi yashetidosona.
Leewe Xeegetetha
Hessafe guye, Yesuusi yaape keyidi bis. Leewe geetetiya issi qaraxa qanxiseysi qaraxa qanxisiya bessan uttidaysa be7idi, “Tana kaalla” yaagis.
I ubbaba aggidi, dendidi iya kaallis.
He Leewey ba son gita gibira giigisis. Daro qaraxa qanxiseysatinne hara asati katha bolla uttidosona.
Farsaawetinne higge astamaareti, “Qaraxa qanxeysataranne nagaranchotara ayis meetinne uyeetii?” yaagidi Yesuusa tamaareta bolla zuuzumidosona.
Yesuusi entako, “Harganchotasafe attishin, paxatas aakime koshshenna.
Taani nagaranchota maarotako zaaranaasafe attishin, geeshshata xeeganaw yabiike” yaagidi zaaris.
Enti Yesuusako, “Yohaanisa tamaareti daro wode xoomosona, woossosona; qassi Farsaaweta tamaaretika hessatho oothosona. Shin neysati ubba wode moosonanne uyoosona” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi entako, “Machiw ekeysi entara de7ishin xeegetida asay xoomana mela oothanaw danda7eetii?
Shin mushuray entafe shaaketana gallasay yaana, he wode enti xoomana.”
Qassi yaagidi leemiso odis; “Ooratha ma7ope peedhidi gal7a ma7o bolla sikey oonika baawa. Hessatho oothiko ooratha ma7uwa peedhees, oorathay gal7aas giigenna.
Mal7anto woyne gal7a ogoron qoliya oonika baawa. Hessa oothiko, ooratha woyney gal7a ogoruwa dhusees; woyney gukees ogoroyka maaddonnaba gidees.
Hessa gisho, ooratha woyney ooratha ogoron qolettanaw bessees.
Hiza, caalay lo77o giya gisho, caala woyne uyi simmidi mal7anto koyey oonika baawa” yaagis.

footnotes.text: Baro harge: Baro hargey asa galba bolla keyiya harge. Isra7eele biittan baro harganchoti hara asaape dummatidi de7oosonape attishin, asaara gahetokona.
